formattedAddress: No. 54-1號, Section 2, Hangzhou S Rd, Xinying Village, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan 100

text.text:
Typical mom and pop place. No frill. Just simply one thing that they are great at which is the shaobing 燒餅. It’s a flatbread and the one here is different than all the other places (Yonghe or Fuhang) because it is thinner and WAY crispy. If you like a crispy outside (think pita chips) with a soft chewing inside, this is your place. No one else does it like this.

Yonghe is soft and moderately crispy. Fuhang is thick bread. This place is straight up crispy.

No line and the owner was very transactional which is totally fine. Very small inside.
